summary: No held name had a thesis-breaking headline or a 4.01, 4.02 or 5.02 8-K today. The news flow was dominated by Apple's post-earnings reaction (memory-cost margin warning, a stream of mixed price-target changes), the tech selloff and Election Day. The only Apple read-through to the book is the tech-weakness backdrop, since Apple is not held. KR (-2.3%) and WMT (-2.3%) fell with no company news in the inputs; the only items are a Kroger procurement-savings release and a Walmart Canada assistant launch, so the move looks like a reversal of October's staples-over-tech rotation (XLP had its best month ever) and not a stock-specific event. IDXX's print is resolved and its 10-Q is filed. BTC/USD rose 1.6% on the day while the Binance hack story kept running (North Korea denies involvement, withdrawals reopening in phases); nothing new tripped the exchange-failure clause. Nothing in the inputs bears on L1 (DPZ re-anchoring was done in the PM reasoning), so I only note that DPZ had no news or filings.
